outcomeNote: only the first of three announced inferences falls in this unit

segments.he: נָשָׂא אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה. שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ תְּלָת: שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ אַחַת בְּחַיָּיו וְאַחַת בְּמוֹתוֹ יֵשׁ לָהֶן כְּתוּבַּת בְּנִין דִּכְרִין, וְלָא חָיְישִׁינַן לְאִינְּצוֹיֵי.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: If «he married the first» woman, etc. The Gemara notes: «Conclude three» conclusions «from this» statement: «Conclude from it» that if «one» of the man’s wives died «in his lifetime and» the other «one» died following «his death,» then the sons of the first wife «are entitled to» collect the «marriage contract concerning male children and we are not concerned» that this would lead to «quarreling.»
